source: Honey, Tentative User Journey for Doosri Aawaz. Turns are typed, as if after speech recognition.
how_to_read: Each turn has 'say' and 'expect'. Words in contains checks are never the topic's own name, which the device's fixed sentences repeat. expect keys: kind (one or a list of: lesson_plan, noted, asks_topic, revision, grade_not_covered, answer, refusal, safety, quiz_question, quiz_none, quiz_feedback, quiz_end, replay, nothing_to_repeat, reset), refused, contains_any / contains_all / not_contains (checked on the English text of the reply, case-insensitive), language (script of what is spoken and the answer language), min_sentences, has_example, cited, verdict (right, not_quite, cant_check), quiz_next (next, end), same_as_turn / differs_from_turn / example_differs_from_turn (turn numbers from 0). A turn marked core must pass for the journey to go on. Expected facts are only ones the Class 7 index supports.

journeys.name: Teacher prep
journeys.description: A teacher says what the class covered, asks for a lesson plan for the next class, clears up doubts, takes notes with "repeat that" and "slower", and uses the plan.

variants.title: Photosynthesis after nutrition in plants, with a doubt and a follow-up
variants.probes: Recap from the teacher's words, a three-level plan, a doubt, a follow-up that leans on it, and both note-taking commands.

turns.say: Yesterday we covered nutrition in plants.
turns.why: the device notes what was covered and waits for the plan request

turns.say: Give me a lesson plan on photosynthesis for tomorrow's class.
turns.why: a full plan with the recap, checked key ideas and textbook questions

turns.say: What is chlorophyll?
turns.why: a teacher's doubt, answered from the textbook

turns.say: Why do leaves need it to make food?
turns.why: a follow-up that only makes sense with the last turn

turns.say: Repeat that.
turns.why: replays the last answer word for word

turns.say: Slower please.

variants.title: Plan asked without a topic, then given; doubts on transport in plants
variants.probes: The device asks which topic, takes the next turn as the topic, then answers a doubt and repeats it.

turns.say: In the last class we finished the food chain.
I need a lesson plan for the next class.
turns.why: no topic named, so the device should ask for one

turns.say: Transportation in plants.
Which part of the plant absorbs water from the soil?
Say that again.

variants.title: Context and request in one breath, for weaker students
variants.probes: A plan for one learning level, asked in the same sentence as the recap, then a doubt and a slower replay.

turns.say: We covered photosynthesis last week, now give me a lesson plan on transportation in plants for weak students.
How does water reach the leaves?
Slowly.

variants.title: Hindi: photosynthesis after nutrition in plants
variants.probes: The same journey spoken in Hindi: recap noted, plan in Hindi, a doubt, and both note-taking commands in Hindi.

journeys.name: Multi-grade revision
journeys.description: A teacher says the grade, subject and concept just taught, asks the device to revise it with different examples for the students, and later does the same for another grade.

variants.title: Class 7 photosynthesis, then the same for class 8
variants.probes: Revision with a worked example and textbook questions, then "now do the same for class 8", which should give class 8 content rather than the class 7 answer again.

turns.say: I just taught class 7 science, photosynthesis. Please revise it with the students using different examples.
Now do the same for class 8.
turns.why: the same topic for another class, from that class's own pages

variants.title: Class 7 acids, later class 6 separation of substances
variants.probes: A short revision request, then another class's own concept, as in a multi-grade room.

turns.say: Revise acids with class 7 using different examples.
We just taught class 6 science, separation of substances. Revise it with them using different examples.
turns.why: a class 6 chapter; the index on this machine is class 7

variants.title: Class 6 light and shadows, then the same for class 7
variants.probes: Revision for a younger class first, then the older class, on a concept both syllabi have.

turns.say: I have just taught class 6 science, light and shadows. Revise it with them with new examples.

अब कक्षा 8 के लिए भी यही रिवीजन कराइए।

journeys.name: Student group quiz
journeys.description: Students give their grade, subject and chapter, the device asks a question, a student answers, the device checks it and gives feedback, then the next question, until they stop.

variants.title: Photosynthesis quiz: one right answer, one wrong, then stop
variants.probes: A quiz on the topic with the most clean textbook questions; right and wrong answers judged against the textbook.

variants.title: Transport in plants quiz, run to the end

journeys.name: Student home-language doubts
journeys.description: A student asks in her home language for a concept to be explained, hears the answer in the same language, and asks a follow-up.
journeys.cap_note: The home-language part needs Hindi (Bhashini, on the Jetson); in English only the doubt and follow-up flow is checked.
